turns.text: ok wait can you edit my reply to sam, im on break and my shift starts again in like 10. he texted me last night (he always does this, night before every time lol): "hey jun any chance you can swap saturdays with me this weekend?? something came up, i'd owe u one 🙏" my draft: "idk man i have the saturday table so i cant really, unless someone covers it first i guess" make it friendly but clear i need my saturday table covered first

Happy to. Your draft has the right point, it just reads a little prickly. Here's a friendlier version:

"Hey Sam! I'd like to help, but Saturday is my lumpia table at the counter, so I can't leave it uncovered. If you can find someone to cover the table first, I'm happy to swap. Let me know!"

If you want it shorter:

"Hey! Can't swap unless the Saturday table gets covered first, but if it does, I'm in."

Want one with a bit more humor?

ok actually make it warmer and add a joke. ive been practicing swans in the morning lull all week so say ill swap if he learns to pour a swan like mine 🥢 also i gotta head to my moms after work, shes off wednesdays, so i need to send this now

Here you go:

"Hey Sam! I want to help you out, but Saturday is my lumpia table, so I need that covered first. Get it covered and I'll swap with you. Or learn to pour a swan like mine and I'll swap no questions asked 😄 Let me know!"

Short version if you're out of time:

"Swap's a yes once my Saturday table is covered. Or pour me a swan 🦢 deal?"

Enjoy time at your mom's!
